clauses.label: sole paragraph
clauses.text:
By virtue of the authority vested in me by section 5317 of title 5 of the 
United States Code, as amended, section 1  of Executive Order No. 
11768,1  of February 20, 1974, placing certain positions in level IV of 
the Executive Schedule, is amended by deleting “(7)  Director of Pro­
gram Analysis and Evaluation, Department of Defense.” and inserting 
in lieu thereof “(7)  Director of Telecommunications and Command 
and Control Systems, Department of Defense.”.
T h e W h it e H o u s e,
March 26, 1974 .
